introSection.title: One shop. Full control. From die design to dispatch.
body: Most component suppliers hand your tooling to one vendor, your cutting to another and your finishing to a third. Every handover is a place where a date slips and nobody owns the problem.

We built Gupta Enterprises the other way. Since 2010 we have designed and built our own dies, fixtures and gauges. Everything that shapes your part's quality, cost and timeline stays in-house — which is why we can commit to a lead time and hold it.

capabilitiesSection.title: Everything your part needs, under one roof
capabilitiesSection.lead: Six in-house capabilities take a component from raw sheet or tube to an inspected, dispatch-ready part.

productsSection.title: Components we manufacture today
productsSection.lead: A representative selection from current production. If your part is not shown here, it is almost certainly still within our process range — send the drawing and we will tell you.

industriesSection.title: Automotive is our core. The capability travels further.
industriesSection.lead: Two decades of automotive tolerances, volumes and audit expectations transfer directly into adjacent high-growth sectors.

whySection.title: Built to be a supplier you don't have to manage
whySection.lead: Procurement teams do not need another vendor to chase. Here is what changes when tooling, fabrication and inspection sit in one place.

processSection.title: From enquiry to dispatch — one controlled flow
processSection.lead: Because tooling, fabrication and inspection are all in-house, we control quality and lead time at every step.

trustSection.title: Trusted across the automotive supply chain
trustSection.lead: We supply components to leading Indian automotive parts manufacturers — many of them repeat, multi-year customers.

ctaBand.title: Send us your drawings — we'll take it from there.
ctaBand.lead: From RFQ to first article to volume supply. Upload a PDF, DWG, DXF or STEP file and we will come back within one working day with feasibility and a costed quotation.
